auth_url.description: Provider authorization endpoint set at setup time (e.g. https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize). With client_id, the card builds the consent URL itself, provider-agnostically.

client_id.description: Public OAuth client id (not a secret). Combined with auth_url to build the consent URL.

default_subject.description: Default subject when the invoke payload omits `subject`.

provider_id.description: OAuth provider identifier used by the upstream Greentic OAuth operations. This must match a provider exposed by the installed Greentic OAuth provider extension.

redirect_uri.description: Full redirect/callback URI the provider redirects back to (the provider extension's ingress URL).
